units.source_text: 黃昏時分，堀木穿著皺巴巴的浴衣，來到我築地的公寓，

en.t: At dusk, Horiki came to my apartment in Tsukiji wearing a rumpled yukata,

units.source_text: 說是今天急用錢，當掉了夏天的衣服，

en.t: saying that he had urgently needed money that day and had pawned his summer clothes,

units.source_text: 如果家中老母發覺了這件事，那可就麻煩大了，

en.t: and that if his elderly mother at home found out, it would be a terrible problem,

units.source_text: 所以想馬上用錢把衣服贖回來，讓我借錢給他。

en.t: so he wanted to redeem the clothes at once and asked me to lend him the money.

units.source_text: 不巧的是我當時也囊空如洗，

en.t: Unfortunately, I too was completely broke at the time,

units.source_text: 只好按照老辦法，吩咐良子去當掉她的衣服。

en.t: so, as usual, I had no choice but to tell Yoshiko to go pawn her clothes.

units.source_text: 因為借給堀木後還剩下點餘錢，就讓良子買來燒酒，

en.t: Since there was still a little money left after lending some to Horiki, I had Yoshiko buy shochu with it,

units.source_text: 我和堀木爬到公寓的樓頂，迎著時而吹來的隅田川帶著臭水溝味的微風，

en.t: and Horiki and I climbed up to the roof of the apartment, facing the faint breeze that sometimes blew from the Sumida River with the smell of a gutter,

units.source_text: 湊合了幾碟簡單的納涼晚宴。

en.t: and made do with a few simple dishes for a shabby evening of cooling off.

units.source_text: 當時，我們開始玩起了猜喜劇名詞和悲劇名詞的遊戲。

en.t: At that point, we began playing a game of guessing comic nouns and tragic nouns.
